decisions.DEC-CUTOFF-001: All formal evidence must exist by the configured premarket cutoff.
decisions.DEC-EXIT-001: Paper exits use a configured RTH submission window that may change only for measured API latency.
decisions.DEC-ENTRY-WINDOW-001: Open canary entries only in the configured post-open operational window.
decisions.DEC-CAP-001: Publish zero to three forecasts without a direction quota.
decisions.DEC-CANARY-001: Use one share per forecast until probability and cost gates pass.
decisions.DEC-FRESHNESS-001: Refresh portfolio and short-capacity snapshots within the configured pre-order age.
decisions.DEC-BATCH-001: Split and retry missing provider snapshot rows without fabricating data.
decisions.DEC-COVERAGE-001: A formal universe snapshot must satisfy the registered coverage gate.
decisions.DEC-SEMANTICS-001: Formal premarket evidence must pass provider field-consistency checks.
decisions.DEC-PRICE-SEMANTICS-001: Resolve previous close from pre-price minus provider change and cross-check the rate.
decisions.DEC-PROBABILITY-GATE-001: Use prospective prequential probabilities and proper-score comparisons before publication.
decisions.DEC-COST-GATE-001: Estimate paper execution cost only from reconciled arrival quotes, fills and fees.
decisions.DEC-NET-EV-GATE-001: Publish net profitability only after prospective paired returns have positive block-bootstrap support and survive leave-one-group-out concentration checks.
decisions.DEC-MARKET-BENCHMARKS-001: Represent equity, duration, dollar, credit and tradable-volatility channels separately; no single instrument is a market vote.
decisions.DEC-SECTOR-BENCHMARKS-001: Use all eleven broad GICS-sector ETFs as exposure context; relation type, not ETF correlation alone, determines spillover.
decisions.DEC-INTEGRATION-001: Publish only when independent causal-context and market-absorption roots align without an independent opposing root; never substitute Agent counts or hand weights.
decisions.DEC-CANDIDATE-INTAKE-001: Deep-review cutoff-safe primary-event symbols and the largest absolute stock-minus-sector premarket residuals after an adaptive cross-sectional participation-maturity gate; intake never assigns direction or strength.
decisions.DEC-AI-BACKEND-001: Formal domain inference requires a runtime-specific macOS kernel-sandbox attestation, inlined verified evidence, fixed structured output and first-valid immutable results; any failed probe disables AI.
decisions.DEC-SEC-VIEW-001: Archive the complete SEC submission and give AI only a deterministic, reproducible visible-text view of configured filing documents; never summarize or truncate to fit.
decisions.DEC-PRICE-HISTORY-001: Give price-volume analysis only T-1 unadjusted regular-session paths and lineage-bound stock-sector premarket residual context; unavailable histories do not receive substitutes.
decisions.DEC-DEEP-EVIDENCE-001: Collect relationship context, event-level order flow and option distributions with explicit provider status; never infer unavailable semantics.
